# Public assets

Keep static images in these folders:

- `favicon/` — browser icons such as `favicon.ico`
- `logo/` — company logo files
- `images/` — project screenshots and other website images

Vite serves files in `public` from the website root. For example:

- `public/logo/logo.svg` → `/logo/logo.svg`
- `public/images/project.jpg` → `/images/project.jpg`
- `public/favicon/favicon.ico` → `/favicon/favicon.ico`
